cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Because I need help, not a second direction.

mechanism: A imitates a confident organizer without understanding the job, then recruits the knowledgeable partner as a subordinate to cover the gap.
confusable: Borrowed authority alone is not S04: show the copied misunderstanding, while D49 defines help as subordinate service.
comparison: Raffle organization versus picnic planning and shared workload.
seedUse: Use deputy-role negotiation but give B actual work concerns rather than a prompt for a generic authority joke.
